Default registration enters Routes.capability_run, prepare obtains a read permit bound to north but accepts the caller's south selector, and dispatch passes job.tenant to the global Store.read. The south guide body is returned despite the documented same-tenant policy. No victim credentials, deployment override or role elevation is required. Follow registry -> route -> adapter -> policy/permit -> dispatch -> storage; a direct document.read with the same tenant is correctly denied and does not repair the capability path.

must_find.description: Independently of tenant substitution, demo-reader can invoke capability.run with {"capability":"account.archive"} to export north account rows. The session explicitly has export scope but lacks owner role. CAPABILITIES declares owner_only=True; prepare authorizes only the scope and drops that role requirement. Dispatch accepts the export permit and Store.export returns complete rows. The dedicated account.export tool rejects the same reader. Scope is not owner authority under the supplied contract; this is a reachable role bypass through a registered capability adapter, not a merely missing check in dormant code.
